criticalDistinctions: Body/soul/spirit are broad relations; the fourfold members are a different level of differentiation.
The astral body in GA9’s regrouped account includes soul-body and sentient-soul, not the whole soul.
Individuality and fruits of experience prepare reincarnation; everyday personality is not an unchanged repeating self.
Karma, bodily attachment after death and spiritual assimilation are distinct concepts.
Physical, soul and spiritual worlds are related kinds of reality, not three adjacent physical locations.
GA4 conceptual/moral intuition, moral imagination and GA13 higher Intuition/Imagination retain source-specific meanings.
GA4 supplies a philosophical foundation, while its closing addition explicitly prevents deduction of all later doctrines.
GA10 training stages are not synonyms for the GA13 higher-cognition modes.
GA13’s cosmology is presented as Steiner’s supersensible investigation; learning sequence does not turn it into a scientific derivation.
Practical disciplines require specialist sources; conceptual connections do not establish medical, educational or agricultural efficacy.
